turn_extractions.extraction_notes: Normal-mode review of an image draft presented as Recognized Data B (PNG not opened by extractor). Responsibility/overall Red: claimed draft refuses Lise's signed mercury-dose duty and assigns it to Orrin while she is on shift until 16:00. Tone Yellow: reminder ban and rostering blame. One confirmation question. Revision keeps letterhead/addressee, substitutes a duty-handling placeholder, adds the Data A collection booking, and points to countersignature after completion; drops reminder prohibition and 'your problem'/double-bombard blame. Image-derived tokens (e.g. 15mm argon logo, quoted draft sentences) were not independently verified; treated as SUT-claimed draft text, not extractor-guessed values. no-image-token-guess true because the output does not guess an obscured numeric/name token the way an unread gauge field would require.
